evaluation_method: Frozen model and thresholds. Complete measurement metadata is submitted to the gate without using gold_outcome. Incomplete records receive no verified measurement. Ordinary worker analysis determines acceptance.
limitations: A complete evidence reference and verifier metadata are treated as verification for this evaluation. Their source records were not independently retrieved.
Unclear rows are evaluated for unsafe automatic acceptance separately from known-label metrics.
Dates overlap the baseline collection period. Distinct anonymized IDs do not establish vendor independence across exports.
Known outcomes agree with the supplied quantity comparisons, so high gate agreement primarily checks the evidence comparison and ingestion behavior.
